Subject: Processing of applications for withdrawal of fund for housing
purpose - Declaration to be obtained with Form 31 under para 68B
of the EPF Scheme 1952.

Reference: This office circular No. WSU/17(4)99/Para 68B/81473-578 dated 12.03.2003

Sir,

As per the existing Scheme provisions, all the advances under para 68B should be
processed on submission of Declaration Form (as conveyed vide this office letter cited) but
in practice, the same is not being uniformly followed in the field offices. They are insisting
for other documents such as Registered Agreement copy, approved plan, link documents,
tax receipts etc.

Accordingly, all the field offices are directed to follow the guidelines already
circulated vide this office letters dated 12.03.2003 & 16.12.2004 (copies enclosed) while
authorizing the withdrawals under para 68B, based on the declaration form without
insisting for any other document. Follow up action as per Sub-Para 10 of Para 68B of EPF
Scheme 1952 is also required to call for the utilization certificate failing which recovery be
initiated against the defaulters.

Yours faithfully,
